title: RCCG Providence Centre
description: Church management system for RCCG Providence Centre, with a secure admin portal, donation tracking and contact management.

title: Englefield Green Montessori
description: Full-stack platform for Englefield Green Montessori School, with a JWT-secured admin dashboard for school news, term dates and the student gallery.

title: Brand designer portfolio
description: Portfolio and booking site for brand strategist and designer Seyi Sorinade.

caseStudy.overview: A personal site for a brand strategist and UI/UX designer. It presents his services and past work and lets visitors book a free consultation.
built: A work section filterable by client type: non-profits, startups, personal brands, small businesses and agencies
Project entries that link out to the designer's Dribbble shots
A services list, an about section, FAQs and a testimonial block
Consultation booking through an external Calendly page
Social links to Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Behance and Dribbble

title: Notification service
description: A multi-channel notification service with a React dashboard. Delivery runs in background workers so the API stays responsive.

caseStudy.overview: Sending an email takes long enough that it should not block the request that asked for it. This project hands delivery to Celery workers and tracks each notification's status so a dashboard can show what happened.
built: A Django REST API to create, list and retrieve notifications
Celery workers that deliver notifications in the background, backed by Redis
Email and WebSocket delivery channels
Statuses that move from pending to processing to sent or failed
A manual retry endpoint for failed notifications
A React and Vite dashboard with dark mode and a responsive layout

title: Todo app
description: A todo REST API built with Django REST Framework, with a separate React frontend.

caseStudy.overview: An early full-stack practice project: a Django REST API with its own authentication app, and a React frontend built with Vite and set up for Netlify.
built: A Django REST Framework API for todos
A separate authentication app in the backend
A React and Vite frontend in its own repository

title: Color Flood
description: A multiplayer, real-time color flood puzzle game. Players join a room, race through levels and see a live leaderboard.

caseStudy.overview: A flood-fill puzzle where you turn the whole board one color in as few moves as possible. Rooms let friends play the same levels and compare scores as they go.
built: Rooms with 6-character codes, shareable by link or code
Unique usernames within each room
A live leaderboard that updates through Supabase Realtime
Many levels, with the board growing from 6x6 upward
Rooms that expire after 60 days, cleaned up by a pg_cron job in Supabase
A room creator who can close the room and send everyone out
A mobile-friendly layout and a splash screen
